title.en: Measure a lifecycle before claiming performance
title.zh: 先测生命周期，再谈性能

predict.en: Which counts must repeat exactly? Which timestamps may vary?
predict.zh: 哪些计数应精确重现？哪些时间戳会变化？

observe.en: Read actual JFR counts and per-path task order. Compare saved repetitions instead of averaging away failed paths.
observe.zh: 读取真实 JFR 计数与任务顺序。逐轮比较，不用平均值掩盖失败路径。

boundary.en: JFR, scheduling and sleeps affect elapsed time. This is not a JMH throughput benchmark.
boundary.zh: JFR、调度与 sleep 会影响耗时；这不是 JMH 吞吐基准。

units.exerciseOrigin: Original Lab exercise; not a university assignment solution

title.en: Bound execution and follow the submitter
title.zh: 限制执行，并跟踪提交者

predict.en: Does CallerRuns overflow mean a rejected request?
predict.zh: CallerRuns 的 overflow 是否代表请求被拒绝？

observe.en: Check submitted = completed + rejected and inspect callerRuns. Follow task 5 from submitted to its terminal event.
observe.zh: 检查提交 = 完成 + 拒绝，以及 callerRuns。跟踪任务 5 的提交到终态。

boundary.en: The C course provides concurrency foundations; rejection-policy behavior is specified by the Java API.
boundary.zh: C 语言课程提供并发基础；拒绝策略的具体行为以 Java API 为准。

units.exerciseOrigin: Original Lab exercise; not a university assignment solution

title.zh: 线程便宜，下游槽位有限

predict.en: For N=7, C=2: predict peak downstream occupancy, waiting tasks and rejected tasks for each policy.
predict.zh: N=7、C=2 时，先预测各策略的下游峰值、等待数与拒绝数。

observe.en: Real virtual threads: unbounded peak 7; queue peak 2 and waiting peak 5; reject completes 2 and rejects 5. Check every task and restored permits.
observe.zh: 真实虚拟线程：无限制峰值 7；排队峰值 2、最多等待 5；拒绝策略完成 2、拒绝 5。检查每个任务和许可归还。

boundary.en: The gate forces overlap. Capacity is a declared local resource limit, not a measured remote server throughput. Waiting count is bounded only by this finite burst.
boundary.zh: 门闩强制重叠。容量是本地声明的资源界限，不是远程服务吞吐测量。等待数仅因有限突发而有界。

units.exerciseOrigin: Original Lab exercise; not a university assignment solution

title.en: Cancel a waiter and a permit holder
title.zh: 取消等待者与许可持有者

predict.en: After cancel(true), can isCancelled be true while a downstream slot remains occupied?
predict.zh: cancel(true) 后，isCancelled 为 true 时下游槽位是否还可能被占用？

observe.en: Queued cancellation never enters downstream. A cooperative holder releases its permit; the ignoring control still occupies it at cancel_snapshot. All permits return after actual work exits.
observe.zh: 等待中取消从未进入下游。协作任务归还许可；忽略中断的对照在 cancel_snapshot 时仍占用许可。实际退出后才归还全部许可。

boundary.en: The 35 ms timeout limits Future.get waiting. It is not an end-to-end deadline. The ignore control has a finite watchdog.
boundary.zh: 35 毫秒只限制 Future.get 等待，不是端到端 deadline。忽略中断的对照有有限 watchdog。

units.exerciseOrigin: Original Lab exercise; not a university assignment solution

title.en: Count work amplification as well as success
title.zh: 同时统计成功与工作放大

predict.en: Which policy spends more downstream attempts, and which intentionally exposes request failures?
predict.zh: 哪个策略花费更多下游尝试？哪个策略会主动暴露请求失败？

observe.en: Compare attempts, successes and failed requests under the same regenerated failure schedule. Modify --failures through lab.py run and explain the changed work.
observe.zh: 比较相同失败计划下的尝试数、成功与失败请求。通过 lab.py run 修改 --failures 并解释工作量变化。

boundary.en: Lecture 2 motivates accounting for work; it does not prescribe a retry algorithm. This Lab uses finite synthetic failures, not a cascading-outage model.
boundary.zh: 第 2 讲用于工作量分析，不是重试算法教学。本实验使用有限合成失败，不是级联故障模型。

units.exerciseOrigin: Original Lab exercise; not a university assignment solution

title.en: Challenge a recording with independent evidence

predict.en: Would a summary-only checker notice a leaked permit, a forged thread type or missing actual JFR transitions?
predict.zh: 只查汇总能否发现许可泄漏、伪造线程类型或缺失的真实 JFR 转换？

observe.en: Replay JSON as a state machine, compare scenario/transition counts with separately read real JFR, then run deliberate corruption checks. Inspect virtual starts/ends and the explicit pinned count.
observe.zh: 将 JSON 重放为状态机，与另一个 JVM 读取的真实 JFR 场景/转换计数比对，再执行故意损坏记录的反例检查。查看虚拟线程开始/结束与明确的 pinned 计数。

boundary.en: JEP 491 changed synchronized blocking in JDK 24. Zero recorded pinned events does not establish universal absence. This is not an LLM evaluation.
boundary.zh: JEP 491 在 JDK 24 改变 synchronized 阻塞行为。未记录 pinned 事件不证明普遍不存在。这不是 LLM 评测。
